title: Refill commercial pricing gun ink roller: open door, eject spent roller, seat fresh ink roller, latch shut
name: refill-commercial-label-pricing-gun-ink-roller
instruction: Refill the commercial pricing gun ink roller: swing open the front ink door, eject the spent ink roller to the waste tray, snap a fresh ink roller into the carrier arms, and latch the door shut.
context: Commercial pricing label guns (Monarch 1131 / Garvey 22-8) are ubiquitous handheld marking tools used across supermarkets, retail stores, warehouses, and logistics centers, impacting over 3,500,000 retail salespersons (BLS SOC 41-2031) and stockers/order fillers (BLS SOC 53-7065). Routine maintenance requires replenishing dried ink rollers to ensure crisp, readable price and date marks on inventory. The operator swings open the front access door past its retention detent, releases the spent ink roller spindle from the spring carrier arms into a waste tray, seats a fresh cylindrical ink roller into the carrier journals until locked, swings the door shut until the detent latch snaps flush, and clears hands to verify retention.
setup: All positions in cm from table center. Commercial label pricing gun housing (18.0 x 12.0 x 4.5 cm, 380 g, red rigid ABS) clamped securely to work fixture at x = 28.0, y = 5.0, z = 7.0 cm. Front ink door hinged at x = 33.5, y = 2.0, z = 7.0 cm on a 100 deg revolute joint. Spent cylindrical ink roller (1.2 cm OD, 2.8 cm length, 8 g, porous black core on rigid steel axle) staged inside carrier. Fresh sealed replacement ink roller (1.2 cm OD, 2.8 cm length, 12 g) staged upright on bench at x = 22.0, y = -14.0, z = 2.0 cm. Discard waste tray located on right bench at x = 36.0, y = 16.0 cm.
scoring: Evaluated at trial end. 0.00 at start. 0.20 when front ink door is swung open past detent (>= 55 deg). 0.45 when spent ink roller is removed from carrier into discard waste tray (> 8 cm from carrier). 0.75 when fresh ink roller is seated into carrier journals (< 1.5 cm horizontal, < 1.2 cm vertical error). 0.90 when front ink door is swung shut onto retention latch (< 5 deg from closed). 1.00 strictly requires spent roller discarded, fresh roller seated, door latched, hands clear (>= 50 mm), and held in equilibrium for >= 1.0 s.
reset_notes: Swing door open, place spent roller back into carrier journals, return fresh roller to staging mark at x = 22.0, y = -14.0 cm, and swing door shut.
fidelity: Rigid bodies. Pricing gun housing collider modeled with true internal cavity and carrier journal stops. Front door modeled with USD Physics revolute joint (0.05 N*m/rad stiffness, 0.10 N*m friction). Fresh and spent ink rollers modeled as rigid cylindrical bodies with PhysX collision meshes.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0; demo: 1.0 (two runs, 320 steps each).
